build_text_generation_pipeline: build a PEFT text generation pipeline that loads a base model and adapter from HuggingFace Hub
run_text_generation: run the TextGenerationPipeline to generate completed text from an input prompt string
review_model_loading: review the TextGenerationPipeline init method that loads base model and PEFT adapter via model_info
refactor_process_req: refactor the _process_req method to customize max_new_tokens or eos_token_id parameters
test_model_to_gpu: test the _model_to_gpu method to verify CUDA device placement when GPU is available
